title: Senior Digital Sales Expert – B2B – Brussels
full_description:
Your Role & Work Environment
As aSeniorDigital Sales Expert, you will be working in Easy Banking, our Digital Sales B2B team driving growth for our Self-employed & Micro companies in Belgium. This is an exciting segment, with a focus on start-ups and entrepreneurs – the backbone of our economy and future growth.
Your success indicator will be theoverall digital & mobile sales contributionwith a focus on managing the full digital buyer journey frompaid & ownedtraffic generation,to mid and lower funnel conversion optimization. Experimentation, AB testing, data analysis & SEO.
Your key responsibilities
As aSeniorDigital Sales Expert, yourchallenge is to increase digital & mobile salesbydriving qualitative paid and owned traffictowards our sales commercial pages in web & app, experimenting, analysing, and changing those pages tooptimize for search engines(mainly Google) andconversionfor our top digital products. You will create a positive customer experience while growing our sales. By conducting research, contribute to the experiment backlog and leveraging on analytic tools, such as Adobe Analytics, you will increase conversion of qualitative traffic of our website that will ultimately lead to digital & mobile sales.
